pages.quiz:
CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #1
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 120 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A child says, "I am better than others because I am unique." What is wrong with this idea? (1 mark)
   A. Nobody is unique
   B. Everyone is unique, so nobody is better because of it
   C. Only rich children are unique
   D. Uniqueness has no meaning

2. Why is knowing your full name important for your safety? (1 mark)
   A. You can forget your family
   B. You can tell a helper who you are if you get lost
   C. You can use it to tease others
   D. You can hide it from your parents

3. Who said, "As for me and my household, we will serve the Lord"? (1 mark)
   A. Peter
   B. Stephen
   C. Joshua
   D. Abraham

4. Which action shows that we care for God's creation? (1 mark)
   A. Hurting animals
   B. Wasting food
   C. Cutting trees for fun
   D. Planting trees and saving water

5. Which verse says that God calls us by name? (1 mark)
   A. Acts 2:38
   B. Exodus 20:12
   C. Isaiah 43:1
   D. Mark 10:52

6. Which of these is the correct way to handle the Bible? (1 mark)
   A. Drop it on the floor
   B. Draw on its pages
   C. Sit on it
   D. Carry it carefully and keep it clean

7. Why did Zacchaeus climb a tree? (1 mark)
   A. He was short and wanted to see Jesus
   B. He was playing
   C. He was hiding from the police
   D. He was collecting fruit

8. Which of these is kind treatment of a donkey? (1 mark)
   A. Beating it
   B. Giving it food, water and rest
   C. Overloading it
   D. Leaving it hungry

9. Which people ruled the Israelites during Samson's time? (1 mark)
   A. The Philistines
   B. The Greeks
   C. The Egyptians
   D. The Romans

10. What did the seven fat cows stand for? (1 mark)
   A. Seven years of famine
   B. Seven years of plenty
   C. Seven rivers
   D. Seven kings

11. Who first told Pharaoh about Joseph? (1 mark)
   A. The baker
   B. The cupbearer
   C. A magician
   D. Potiphar

12. What is a patriarch? (1 mark)
   A. The father and leader of a family or nation
   B. A soldier
   C. A prophet
   D. A king

13. What was Abram's name changed to? (1 mark)
   A. Abraham
   B. Isaac
   C. Israel
   D. Jacob

14. Who was told about the birth of Jesus in a dream? (1 mark)
   A. Pilate
   B. Herod
   C. Joseph
   D. Zechariah

15. What name did the angel tell Mary to give her son? (1 mark)
   A. Gabriel
   B. Jesus
   C. John
   D. Emmanuel only

16. Which angel appeared to Mary? (1 mark)
   A. Peter
   B. Raphael
   C. Michael
   D. Gabriel

17. How did Zechariah get his speech back? (1 mark)
   A. After a long sleep
   B. After visiting Jerusalem
   C. After a healing by Jesus
   D. After writing "His name is John"

18. How did the crowd treat him at first? (1 mark)
   A. They carried him
   B. They told him to be quiet
   C. They gave him money
   D. They ignored Jesus

19. What did he ask Jesus for? (1 mark)
   A. A house
   B. Mercy, and to see
   C. Food
   D. Money

20. Who was the one who returned? (1 mark)
   A. A priest
   B. A Samaritan
   C. A Pharisee
   D. A Roman

21. What should we do when we face problems? (1 mark)
   A. Pray and ask for help
   B. Hide
   C. Give up
   D. Blame others

22. Why should we help promptly? (1 mark)
   A. Needs may be urgent
   B. Nobody needs help
   C. Delay is better
   D. Helping is a waste

23. Who shared five loaves and two fish in John 6? (1 mark)
   A. A priest
   B. A boy
   C. A king
   D. A soldier

24. What is a harambee? (1 mark)
   A. A holiday
   B. A school game
   C. People pooling resources to help someone
   D. A kind of fruit

25. How many silver coins did the woman have? (1 mark)
   A. Five
   B. Twelve
   C. Ten
   D. Two

26. What does a person do when they repent, causing joy in heaven? (1 mark)
   A. To ignore sin
   B. To blame others
   C. To hide sin
   D. They are sorry for sin and turn away from it

27. Which value do we learn when we plant and water a seed? (1 mark)
   A. Laziness
   B. Greed
   C. Jealousy
   D. Responsibility and patience

28. Who baptised Jesus? (1 mark)
   A. Peter
   B. Paul
   C. John the Baptist
   D. Stephen

29. Which of these is a sign of an unsafe secret? (1 mark)
   A. It makes you feel scared or uncomfortable
   B. It is about a surprise gift
   C. It is about a game
   D. It makes you happy

30. Who ate the fruit God had forbidden? (1 mark)
   A. Abraham and Sarah
   B. Joseph and Mary
   C. Peter and John
   D. Adam and Eve

31. Who is your neighbour? (1 mark)
   A. Only people next door
   B. Anyone near you or in need
   C. Only friends
   D. Only relatives

32. What does responsibility mean? (1 mark)
   A. Being lazy
   B. Leaving jobs to others
   C. Breaking things
   D. Doing your duties and caring for what belongs to you

33. What does Luke 16:10 teach? (1 mark)
   A. Whoever is trusted with little can be trusted with much
   B. Be greedy
   C. Do not work
   D. Money is evil

34. What did God tell the first man to do in the garden, according to Genesis 2:15? (1 mark)
   A. Sleep
   B. Sell it
   C. Leave it
   D. Work it and take care of it

35. Which of these is harmful to the body? (1 mark)
   A. Water
   B. Alcohol and drugs
   C. Sleep
   D. Vegetables

36. Which of these shows respect for others' bodies? (1 mark)
   A. Not hitting or bullying
   B. Touching without permission
   C. Hitting
   D. Bullying

37. What are the two meanings of the word church? (1 mark)
   A. A river and a hill
   B. The building and the people of God
   C. A market and a school
   D. A song and a prayer

38. Which fruit is shown by keeping a promise? (1 mark)
   A. Selfishness
   B. Anger
   C. Envy
   D. Faithfulness

39. How can we grow the fruit of the Spirit? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore the Bible
   B. Only watch TV
   C. Only sleep
   D. Pray, read the Bible and practise

40. Why should you not chat with strangers online? (1 mark)
   A. It is free
   B. It is fun
   C. They may not be who they say they are
   D. They are always kind

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
41. Describe four ways in which children can serve in church. (4 marks)

42. Explain Ephesians 4:26 and show how a child can apply it when a friend has hurt them. (5 marks)

43. Explain why obedience is important at home and at school, and when a child should not obey. (5 marks)

44. Explain what it means to repent as taught in Acts 2:38 and how a child can do it. (5 marks)

45. Explain why sexual purity is important and how children can begin to live a holy life like Mary. (5 marks)

46. Explain what the story teaches about gratitude and give one example from school life. (4 marks)

47. State four ways of looking after your body as God's special creation. (4 marks)

48. Explain the two greatest commandments and how a child can obey them. (5 marks)

49. Give three reasons why we should read the Bible. (3 marks)

50. State two reasons why we should tell the truth. (2 marks)

51. State two lessons from the story of Stephen. (2 marks)

52. Describe four ways in which a child can trust God in life's challenges. (4 marks)

53. Describe four ways in which God shows that He is a loving Father. (4 marks)

54. Explain how to find Luke 19:1-10 in the Bible. (4 marks)

55. Who was Nicodemus? (2 marks)

56. Explain what "forgive" means. (2 marks)
pages.answers:
CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #1 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. B — Everyone is unique, so nobody is better because of it
   All people are unique and special to God, so it is not a reason to boast.

2. B — You can tell a helper who you are if you get lost
   A name helps people identify you and help you find your family.

3. C — Joshua
   Joshua 24:15 records these words.

4. D — Planting trees and saving water
   Caring for the environment honours the Creator.

5. C — Isaiah 43:1
   Isaiah 43:1 says, "I have called you by name."

6. D — Carry it carefully and keep it clean
   We respect the Bible because it is God's word.

7. A — He was short and wanted to see Jesus
   The crowd was large, and he was short.

8. B — Giving it food, water and rest
   Kindness to animals includes meeting their needs.

9. A — The Philistines
   The Philistines oppressed Israel in the days of Samson.

10. B — Seven years of plenty
   Joseph explained that they were seven good years.

11. B — The cupbearer
   The cupbearer remembered Joseph from prison.

12. A — The father and leader of a family or nation
   Abraham, Isaac and Jacob are called patriarchs.

13. A — Abraham
   Genesis 17:5 records the new name.

14. C — Joseph
   Matthew 1:20 says an angel appeared to Joseph in a dream.

15. B — Jesus
   Luke 1:31 says to call Him Jesus.

16. D — Gabriel
   Luke 1:26 says God sent the angel Gabriel.

17. D — After writing "His name is John"
   His mouth was opened when he wrote the name.

18. B — They told him to be quiet
   Many rebuked him and told him to be quiet.

19. B — Mercy, and to see
   He asked for mercy and said, "I want to see."

20. B — A Samaritan
   The one who returned was a Samaritan.

21. A — Pray and ask for help
   We can bring our worries to God and to trusted adults.

22. A — Needs may be urgent
   Quick help reduces suffering.

23. B — A boy
   A boy's lunch was used to feed a large crowd.

24. C — People pooling resources to help someone
   Harambee means pulling together to help.

25. C — Ten
   She had ten silver coins.

26. D — They are sorry for sin and turn away from it
   Repenting means turning back to God.

27. D — Responsibility and patience
   Caring for a plant teaches responsibility.

28. C — John the Baptist
   Matthew 3:13-17 says John baptised Jesus.

29. A — It makes you feel scared or uncomfortable
   Bad secrets should be told to trusted adults.

30. D — Adam and Eve
   Genesis 3 tells about Adam and Eve.

31. B — Anyone near you or in need
   A neighbour is anyone we can help.

32. D — Doing your duties and caring for what belongs to you
   Responsibility means doing what is expected.

33. A — Whoever is trusted with little can be trusted with much
   Faithfulness in small things matters.

34. D — Work it and take care of it
   Genesis 2:15 says this.

35. B — Alcohol and drugs
   Drugs and alcohol harm the body.

36. A — Not hitting or bullying
   We respect others as God's creation.

37. B — The building and the people of God
   Church means the building and the community.

38. D — Faithfulness
   Faithfulness is loyalty.

39. D — Pray, read the Bible and practise
   Practice and prayer help.

40. C — They may not be who they say they are
   People online can pretend.

SECTION B
----
41. (4 marks)
   Answer: Sing in the choir, help clean, welcome visitors, read a verse, take the offering, help in Sunday school.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each way up to 4.

42. (5 marks)
   Answer: Ephesians 4:26 says to be angry without sinning and not to keep the anger overnight. A child should calm down, avoid hitting or insulting, talk to the friend kindly or ask an adult to help, forgive, and pray for peace before the day ends.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the meaning of the verse, 1 for not sinning in anger, 1 for calming down, 1 for talking or forgiving, 1 for prayer or making peace quickly.

43. (5 marks)
   Answer: Obedience brings peace at home, safety and learning at school. It pleases God. A child should not obey instructions that are unsafe or hurt them or others. In that case they should say no and tell a trusted adult.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for home peace, 1 for school learning, 1 for pleasing God, 1 for not obeying harmful instructions, 1 for telling a trusted adult.

44. (5 marks)
   Answer: Repent means to be sorry for sin and turn away from it. Peter told people to repent and be baptised. A child can admit wrong, tell God sorry, ask forgiveness from others, make a decision to do better and ask the Holy Spirit's help.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the meaning, 1 for Acts 2:38, 1 for admitting, 1 for saying sorry, 1 for deciding to do better.

45. (5 marks)
   Answer: The body is a gift from God, and sexual relations are meant for marriage. Purity keeps us safe and honours God. Children can begin by respecting their bodies, avoiding harmful places and media, obeying parents, praying and saying no to wrong.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for body as gift, 1 for marriage, 1 for honouring God, 1 for respecting body or avoiding harm, 1 for a prayer or obedience.

46. (4 marks)
   Answer: Jesus noticed that only one of the ten returned to thank Him. We should be thankful to God and to people. Example: thanking a teacher who helped with a difficult lesson.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the lesson, 1 for Jesus noticing, 1 for a school example, 1 for explanation of gratitude.

47. (4 marks)
   Answer: Eat healthy food, keep clean, rest and exercise, avoid harmful things such as drugs, do not hurt yourself or others.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid way, up to 4.

48. (5 marks)
   Answer: Love God with all your heart, soul and mind, and love your neighbour as yourself. A child obeys by praying, reading the Bible, going to church, and by kindness, sharing and forgiving others.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for loving God, 1 for loving neighbour, 1 for prayer or Bible, 1 for kindness, 1 for forgiving or sharing.

49. (3 marks)
   Answer: It teaches right from wrong, comforts us, helps us to know God, gives stories of people who followed God.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid reason.

50. (2 marks)
   Answer: God commands it; people trust us; we feel peaceful; friendships stay strong.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid reason.

51. (2 marks)
   Answer: Be brave; forgive; trust God.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

52. (4 marks)
   Answer: Pray; read the Bible; ask trusted adults; do their best; thank God.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid way, up to 4.

53. (4 marks)
   Answer: He gives life, food, water and air; gives families; forgives when we are sorry; knows us by name; sent Jesus to save us.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid way, up to 4.

54. (4 marks)
   Answer: Use the contents page to find the book of Luke. Turn to chapter 19. Then find verses 1 to 10 within that chapter.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for finding the book, 1 for the chapter, 1 for the verses, 1 for using the contents page.

55. (2 marks)
   Answer: A Pharisee and a member of the Jewish ruling council who visited Jesus at night.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for Pharisee or leader and 1 for visiting Jesus.

56. (2 marks)
   Answer: To stop being angry with someone and not pay them back for the wrong they did.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for stopping anger and 1 for not paying back.
